Scrolling Textures puts animated, glowing skins on your weapons. A pattern slowly scrolls over the gun and lights up, and you can pick the skin per weapon slot in the options menu.

# Functions
* Animated glow skins for your primary and secondary weapon, picked in the options menu
* Only touches your own weapon. Teammates, bots and enemies keep their normal look
* Material configs for the weapon parts are generated by the mod itself the first time you start the game
* Overridden by skin in weapon select
* Switch it all off with one toggle, and decide whether menus and the inventory show the effect
* Optional tuneable extras: 
  * glow brightness, 
  * bloom, 
  * scroll speed, 
  * breathing pulse, 
  * flash on shot, 
  * glow illuminating the area
 * Drop your own skins into ./input/
 * Hotreload button
   * no restart needed (works in the menu and on your weapon mid-heist)

Compatible (usable, non-interfering) with [Animated Weapon Skins](https://modworkshop.net/mod/59388)
